:::{#def-conditional-entropy}
#### Conditional entropy

For $X$ and $Y$ as in @def-joint-entropy,
write $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$ and $p(y \mid x) \eqdef \P(Y=y \mid X=x)$.
The entropy of $Y$ given one value $x$ of $X$ is

$$H(Y \mid X=x) \eqdef -\sum_{y} p(y \mid x) \log p(y \mid x).$$

The **conditional entropy** of $Y$ given $X$
averages it over the distribution of $X$:

$$H(Y \mid X) \eqdef \sum_{x} p(x) \, H(Y \mid X=x).$$

Each sum runs over the values with positive probability.

:::
